changeSet.sql: create or alter procedure [dbo].[GetResponsibilityTypeBreakdown] ( @responsibilityTypeUid uniqueidentifier = NULL ) as begin select s.ResponsibilityTypeID, s.ResponsibilityTypeUid, s.ResponsibilityTypeName as ResponsibilityType, s.ResponsibilityTypeName, count(1) as [Count] from dbo.ResponsibilitySummary s where (@responsibilityTypeUid IS NULL OR [ResponsibilityTypeUID] = @responsibilityTypeUid) group by s.ResponsibilityTypeID, s.ResponsibilityTypeUid, s.ResponsibilityTypeName order by s.ResponsibilityTypeName end
